<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$home = get_page_by_path( 'home', OBJECT, 'page' );

if ( ! $home instanceof WP_Post ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'The imported Home page could not be found.' );
}

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', (int) $home->ID );

options.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$menu_name = 'Main Menu';

// Ensure the menu exists.
$menu_term = get_term_by('name', $menu_name, 'nav_menu');
if (!$menu_term || is_wp_error($menu_term)) {
  $menu_id = wp_create_nav_menu($menu_name);
} else {
  $menu_id = (int) $menu_term->term_id;
}

// Load existing assignments and update the primary location.
$locations = get_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations');
if (!is_array($locations)) { $locations = []; }

$locations['primary'] = $menu_id;
set_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', $locations);
?>
